bugs.what: A 'stub oracle' NPC appears at the Village Gate (on return visit) offering 'ask stub oracle: (stub) end the tale here' — reads as leftover developer/debug content exposed in normal play, not an in-fiction character.
Exit lists sometimes mark a direction with an asterisk (e.g. 'D* E*' at the Barrow Antechamber) with no legend explaining what the asterisk means; meaning has to be inferred from context.

confusions: The 'stub oracle' debug-looking NPC broke immersion and left it unclear whether it was safe to interact with or a real shortcut to a bad ending.
Asterisked exits (D* E*) are not explained anywhere, unlike explicitly locked directions which do state their condition inline (e.g. 'go up (locked: read the stone verse...)').
suggestions: Remove or flag the 'stub oracle' / '(stub) end the tale here' option before this build reaches players.
Add a one-time inline legend for the '*' exit marker, the same way locked exits already self-explain.

The Ashwood has several transit-only rooms (Camp Smoke, Broken Bridge, Ashfall Clearing, Tower Shadow, Crow Perch, Herb Hollow, Last Trees) that cost a turn each with little payoff; either trim them or let 'travel to a known place' shortcut through them sooner so exploration doesn't eat the whole turn budget.

Surface an explicit 'Act 1 complete' beat when the king is settled (score hit 100/100 here) so a session that stops there still reads as having reached a real milestone, since the campaign continues into six more holds well past a 120-turn session.
